review_method: Read-only source/diff/contracts and saved raw evidence; no builds, tests, probes, services, environment repairs or product execution. Only this report written.

checked.facts: Driver requires root and private root-owned mode0700 control path, retains strict empty-runtime-state guard, creates exclusive lock and owned listener, then scans command records before returning Driver. Scan uses symlink_metadata, accepts only recognized decimal stems with stdout/stderr/command.json/exit.json suffixes, rejects nonregular/malformed/overflow records; largest observed stem seeds sequence. Checked increment happens before new output creation. Existing record bytes are not written, moved or deleted.
checked.boundary: Single administrator-owned control directory and no concurrent privileged mutator; lock excludes another admitted controller. Incomplete historical output records still reserve their numbers. Non-UTF8 filenames cannot alias generated ASCII stems.
checked.failure_cleanup: Initialization scan errors remove only newly created owned socket/lock, then return error; removal failures are not elevated to readiness. Runtime-state/adoption guard remains unchanged.

checked.facts: Trusted source tree and destination parent checks preserve ownership/no-group-or-world-write/no-link/regular-or-directory/256-entry limits. Fresh owned bundle/rootfs is created; files copied as bytes, not hard links, directories separately created; safe permission bits reapplied and final destination trusted-tree verified. OCI points to that private root with readonly true. Template and old mutable bundles are retained.
checked.toctou_boundary: Source validation and fs::copy/read_dir are path-based; fs::copy can follow a source replaced after symlink_metadata. All source ancestry/entries are root-owned and non-group/world-writable, and destination is under private root-owned control. Thus an unprivileged workload cannot perform this race; this review accepts the existing trusted-administrator/no-concurrent-privileged-mutation boundary. It does not claim descriptor-based resistance to a concurrent root mutator. Whole-template before/after lstat/hash observer is additional runtime evidence, not such a product guarantee.
